## Description

Please include a summary of the change, related issues, and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 💄 UI/UX refinement
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Test suite enhancement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding conventions and formatting standards (`cargo fmt`).
- [ ] I have run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and resolved any warnings.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] Existing and new unit tests pass locally (`cargo test -- --nocapture`).
- [ ] I have verified the UI in both Light Mode and Dark Graphite Mode.
- [ ] I have updated documentation or keyboard shortcuts if applicable.
